counter_prior.note: cases where claude_code is NOT acceptable

confidence_raw_descriptive.note: descriptive only: raw, uncalibrated, never used as a threshold

claims: Small synthetic set: results describe THIS set only and are not a statistical estimate of production accuracy.

Fresh-context blinded model review, NOT independent human review. Author has seen prior dev and v1 evidence.
